hook: AI shows what it really costs

beats.say: Paying only the minimum? This AI agent shows what it really costs. Give it your balances and one line.

screen.text: make me a payoff plan with $200 extra a month

beats.say: It runs the math month by month, highest interest first, and compares it to paying only the minimums.

screen.title: Running the math
lines: add $200 a month, highest rate first
